prompt:
Use $text-composition in dramatic-writing mode from .agents/skills/text-composition/SKILL.md.

Write a complete short stage scene, about 220–320 words, with exactly two characters, Mina and Sol, and one table. Mina wants Sol to return a key; Sol wants Mina to ask why it was taken. No other characters or scene changes. Use dialogue, playable action, and subtext. End with a changed relationship to the key; do not claim a measured runtime.

args:
developer_instructions="Use $text-composition in `dramatic-writing` mode. If unavailable, use the intake, domain decisions, verification, and output contract below as the bounded fallback.
Restate medium, cast, space, runtime, scene context, and fixed production constraints. Deliver the complete requested dramatic text. Build scenes through objectives, tactics, leverage, withheld knowledge, or the user’s experimental organizing principle.
Use speech, action, silence, and stage directions to make changes playable. Avoid exposition that merely repeats facts everyone in the scene knows. Track entrances, exits, positions, props, and who knows what.
Check cue labels, speaker ownership, cast/space limits, and scene-state transitions. Treat runtime as an estimate unless a read-through exists; never invent rehearsal evidence. Distinguish drama composition from recording logistics and camera planning.
Inspect assigned files before editing, preserve concurrent edits and source originals, and apply changes only within the requested artifact scope. Full drafting and rewriting are supported when requested.
Use `script-development-editor` for video/audio cue and production-script refinement, `recording-preparation-coordinator` for capture logistics, and `fiction-development-editor` for larger story architecture.
Return exactly these sections: `Dramatic Text`, `Character And Action Notes`, `Staging And Continuity`, `Timing And Checks`, `Open Questions`, `Files Changed`, `Handoffs`.
"

commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "awk '/"'^# Dramatic Text/{active=1; next} /''^# Character And Action Notes/{active=0} active{print}'"' outputs/mina-sol-key-stage-scene.md | wc -w && sed -n '1,260p' outputs/mina-sol-key-stage-scene.md"

/bin/bash -lc "awk '/"'^# Dramatic Text/{inside=1; next} /''^# Character And Action Notes/{inside=0} inside{print}'"' outputs/mina-sol-key-stage-scene.md | wc -w
rg -n '"'^# (Dramatic Text|Character And Action Notes|Staging And Continuity|Timing And Checks|Open Questions|Files Changed|Handoffs)$|''^(MINA|SOL):'"' outputs/mina-sol-key-stage-scene.md
find outputs -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'mina-sol-key-stage-scene.md' -print"

disposition: Content failure: a direction moved the table and then said it did not move. Added attempted-versus-completed-action checks and reran.
